dedupe_keys.name: the china industrial water withdrawal dataset ciww a gridded monthly industrial water withdrawal data in china from 1965 to 2020

description: The CIWW research team publishes gridded monthly industrial water withdrawal across China from January 1965 to December 2020. The dataset has 0.1-degree and 0.25-degree versions, with NetCDF withdrawals in millimetres per month and cell areas for conversion to cubic metres. Figshare provides the files, a readme and an industrial-subsector spreadsheet publicly and free under CC-BY-4.0. The April 2024 revision updates seasonal allocation for electricity and heat production. A practical limitation is that directly opening the file in ArcGIS may display cell_area, not withdrawal; users must select iww_layer and the time dimension to recover the 672 monthly bands. These are spatially allocated estimates, not individual industrial meter records. They can constrain industrial water demand and energy-water dependencies in hydrological simulations. The data complement the separate mapping code and national water-use totals. No NetCDF arrays were downloaded.
